import { v } from 'convex/values'
import { query, mutation } from './_generated/server'
import { internal } from './_generated/api'
import {
  getClerkOrganizationRole,
  requireIdentity,
  requireActiveClerkOrganization,
  requireTenantRole,
  type TenantRole,
} from './authHelpers'
import type { Id } from './_generated/dataModel'
import { ensureCaregiverEmployeeProfile } from './employeeProfiles'

export const list = query({
  args: {},
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    const identity = await requireIdentity(ctx)
    const memberships = await ctx.db
      .query('tenantMembers')
      .withIndex('by_clerk_user_id', (q) =>
        q.eq('clerkUserId', identity.subject),
      )
      .collect()

    const tenants = []
    for (const m of memberships) {
      const tenant = await ctx.db.get(m.tenantId)
      if (tenant) {
        tenants.push({ ...tenant, role: m.role })
      }
    }
    return tenants
  },
})

export const get = query({
  args: { clerkOrgId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { clerkOrgId }) => {
    const { tenant, role } = await requireTenantRole(ctx, clerkOrgId, [
      'org:admin',
      'org:coordinator',
      'org:caregiver',
    ])
    return { ...tenant, role }
  },
})

export const create = mutation({
  args: {
    clerkOrgId: v.string(),
    name: v.string(),
    slug: v.string(),
  },
  handler: async (ctx, { clerkOrgId, name, slug }) => {
    const identity = await requireIdentity(ctx)
    requireActiveClerkOrganization(identity, clerkOrgId)

    const existing = await ctx.db
      .query('tenants')
      .withIndex('by_clerk_org_id', (q) => q.eq('clerkOrgId', clerkOrgId))
      .unique()

    if (existing) {
      throw new Error('Tenant already exists for this organization.')
    }

    const tenantId = await ctx.db.insert('tenants', {
      clerkOrgId,
      name,
      slug,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    })

    await ctx.db.insert('tenantMembers', {
      tenantId,
      clerkUserId: identity.subject,
      role: getClerkOrganizationRole(identity) ?? 'org:admin',
      displayName: identity.name ?? identity.email ?? 'User',
      email: identity.email ?? '',
    })

    return tenantId
  },
})

export const ensureSelectedAgency = mutation({
  args: {
    clerkOrgId: v.string(),
    name: v.string(),
    slug: v.string(),
    displayName: v.string(),
    email: v.string(),
  },
  handler: async (ctx, { clerkOrgId, name, slug, displayName, email }) => {
    const identity = await requireIdentity(ctx)
    requireActiveClerkOrganization(identity, clerkOrgId)

    const tenant = await ctx.db
      .query('tenants')
      .withIndex('by_clerk_org_id', (q) => q.eq('clerkOrgId', clerkOrgId))
      .unique()

    let tenantId: Id<'tenants'>
    let isNewTenant = false

    if (!tenant) {
      tenantId = await ctx.db.insert('tenants', {
        clerkOrgId,
        name,
        slug,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      isNewTenant = true
    } else {
      tenantId = tenant._id
    }

    const existingMember = await ctx.db
      .query('tenantMembers')
      .withIndex('by_tenant_user', (q) =>
        q.eq('tenantId', tenantId).eq('clerkUserId', identity.subject),
      )
      .unique()

    if (existingMember) {
      await ctx.db.patch(existingMember._id, {
        displayName,
        email,
      })
      return { tenantId, memberId: existingMember._id, isNewTenant }
    }

    const roleFromClerk = getClerkOrganizationRole(identity)
    const role: TenantRole = isNewTenant
      ? 'org:admin'
      : roleFromClerk ?? 'org:caregiver'

    const memberId = await ctx.db.insert('tenantMembers', {
      tenantId,
      clerkUserId: identity.subject,
      role,
      displayName,
      email,
    })

    if (role === 'org:caregiver') {
      const newMember = await ctx.db.get(memberId)
      if (newMember) {
        const employeeProfileId = await ensureCaregiverEmployeeProfile(
          ctx,
          tenantId,
          newMember,
        )
        if (employeeProfileId) {
          await ctx.scheduler.runAfter(0, internal.adpOutbound.adpSyncWorker, {
            employeeProfileId,
          })
        }
      }
    }

    return { tenantId, memberId, isNewTenant }
  },
})

export const updateBillingSettings = mutation({
  args: {
    clerkOrgId: v.string(),
    defaultRate: v.number(),
    exportFormat: v.union(v.literal('csv'), v.literal('json')),
  },
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const { tenantId } = await requireTenantRole(ctx, args.clerkOrgId, [
      'org:admin',
    ])
    await ctx.db.patch(tenantId, {
      billingSettings: {
        defaultRate: args.defaultRate,
        exportFormat: args.exportFormat,
      },
    })
  },
})

import {
  type NoteDraft,
  type TaskDraft,
  type LoadedTask,
  validateDocumentationDraft,
} from './documentationDraft'

export const WIZARD_STEPS = [
  {
    id: 'when',
    label: 'When',
    prompt: 'When were you there?',
    helper: 'Check the times are right. Tap to change if needed.',
    accent: 'text-atria-step-when',
    bgAccent: 'bg-atria-step-when',
    borderAccent: 'border-atria-step-when',
    fields: ['startTime', 'endTime'] as const,
  },
  {
    id: 'what',
    label: 'What',
    prompt: 'What did you help with?',
    helper: 'Tap everything you did today. You can pick more than one.',
    accent: 'text-atria-step-what',
    bgAccent: 'bg-atria-step-what',
    borderAccent: 'border-atria-step-what',
    fields: ['servicesProvided'] as const,
  },
  {
    id: 'how',
    label: 'How',
    prompt: 'How did the visit go?',
    helper: 'Tell us in your own words what you helped with and how {clientName} was doing.',
    accent: 'text-atria-step-how',
    bgAccent: 'bg-atria-step-how',
    borderAccent: 'border-atria-step-how',
    fields: ['narrative'] as const,
  },
  {
    id: 'goal',
    label: 'Goal',
    prompt: 'Did you work on her goals?',
    helper: "These are {clientName}'s care plan goals. Tap the ones you helped with today.",
    accent: 'text-atria-step-goal',
    bgAccent: 'bg-atria-step-goal',
    borderAccent: 'border-atria-step-goal',
    fields: ['servicesProvided'] as const,
  },
  {
    id: 'issues',
    label: 'Issues',
    prompt: 'Anything we should know?',
    helper: 'Did anything go wrong, or did {clientName} seem unwell? It\'s okay if not.',
    accent: 'text-atria-step-issues',
    bgAccent: 'bg-atria-step-issues',
    borderAccent: 'border-atria-step-issues',
    fields: ['clientResponse'] as const,
  },
  {
    id: 'done',
    label: 'Done',
    prompt: 'One last look ðŸ‘€',
    helper: 'Check everything looks right, then send it to your coordinator.',
    accent: 'text-atria-step-done',
    bgAccent: 'bg-atria-step-done',
    borderAccent: 'border-atria-step-done',
    fields: [] as const,
  },
] as const

export type WizardStepId = (typeof WIZARD_STEPS)[number]['id']

export function stepIndexFor(id: WizardStepId): number {
  return WIZARD_STEPS.findIndex((step) => step.id === id)
}

export function validateStep(
  stepId: WizardStepId,
  note: NoteDraft,
  taskDrafts: TaskDraft[],
  tasks: LoadedTask[],
): string[] {
  const blockers = validateDocumentationDraft(note, taskDrafts, tasks)

  if (stepId === 'when') {
    return blockers.filter(
      (b) =>
        b.includes('Start time') ||
        b.includes('End time') ||
        b.includes('must be after'),
    )
  }

  if (stepId === 'what') {
    return blockers.filter((b) => b.includes('Services provided'))
  }

  if (stepId === 'how') {
    return blockers.filter((b) => b.includes('Narrative'))
  }

  if (stepId === 'goal') {
    return []
  }

  if (stepId === 'issues') {
    return blockers.filter((b) =>
      tasks.some((task) => b.includes(task.title)),
    )
  }

  return blockers
}

export function noteFieldsForStep(stepId: WizardStepId): Partial<NoteDraft> {
  const step = WIZARD_STEPS.find((s) => s.id === stepId)
  const patch: Partial<NoteDraft> = {}
  for (const field of step?.fields ?? []) {
    switch (field) {
      case 'startTime':
        patch.startTime = ''
        break
      case 'endTime':
        patch.endTime = ''
        break
      case 'servicesProvided':
        patch.servicesProvided = ''
        break
      case 'clientResponse':
        patch.clientResponse = ''
        break
      case 'narrative':
        patch.narrative = ''
        break
    }
  }
  return patch
}

export function buildAutosavePatch(
  stepId: WizardStepId,
  note: NoteDraft,
): Partial<NoteDraft> {
  const step = WIZARD_STEPS.find((s) => s.id === stepId)
  if (!step) return {}
  const patch: Partial<NoteDraft> = {}
  for (const field of step.fields) {
    switch (field) {
      case 'startTime':
        patch.startTime = note.startTime
        break
      case 'endTime':
        patch.endTime = note.endTime
        break
      case 'servicesProvided':
        patch.servicesProvided = note.servicesProvided
        break
      case 'clientResponse':
        patch.clientResponse = note.clientResponse
        break
      case 'narrative':
        patch.narrative = note.narrative
        break
    }
  }
  return patch
}

export function isStepComplete(
  stepId: WizardStepId,
  note: NoteDraft,
  taskDrafts: TaskDraft[],
  tasks: LoadedTask[],
): boolean {
  return validateStep(stepId, note, taskDrafts, tasks).length === 0
}

export { validateDocumentationDraft }

.hermes-pipeline\20260603_165807\review_codex_iter3.md:60:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260603_165807\review_codex_iter3.md:63:Add a Vitest unit test file at src/shared/format.test.ts that thoroughly tests the three exported functions in src/shared/format.ts (formatCurrency, formatHours, formatStatusLabel), including edge cases (zero, negative, fractional values, multi-word underscore strings). Follow the repo style: single quotes, no semicolons, 2-space indent. Do NOT modify format.ts. Vitest runs with globals enabled so describe/it/expect do not need imports.

(3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter3.prompt.md:1534:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter3.prompt.md:1537:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter3.prompt.md:2961:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter3.prompt.md:2964:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter2.prompt.md:7:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter2.prompt.md:10:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter2.prompt.md:1532:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter2.prompt.md:1535:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. .hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\plan_final.md:183:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\plan_final.md:186:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter1.prompt.md:7:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\fix_iter1.prompt.md:10:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\implement.prompt.md:1524:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter2.md:1459:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter2.md:1462:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

[FieldGroup.tsx](C:/Users/pinol/Documents/Work/atriax/solid-pancake/src/shared/ui/FieldGroup.tsx:24) computes a fallback `baseId`, and helper/error text is wired to the child, but the rendered label still uses only `htmlFor` at [FieldGroup.tsx](C:/Users/pinol/Documents/Work/atriax/solid-pancake/src/shared/ui/FieldGroup.tsx:39). In common usage like `<FieldGroup label="Name"><input /></FieldGroup>`, the visible label is not programmatically associated with the input. .hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter1.md:40:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter1.md:43:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.prompt.md:10:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.prompt.md:13:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. .hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter4.md:32:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter4.md:35:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\plan_codex.md:29:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\plan_codex.md:32:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.md:32:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.md:35:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.md:1458:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.md:1461:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.md:2885:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_codex_iter3.md:2888:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. .hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_opus_iter3.prompt.md:10:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
.hermes-pipeline\20260604_163200\review_opus_iter3.prompt.md:13:Stage 0 foundation: add reference-INDEPENDENT, additive UI primitives and accessibility/size improvements to the shared design system, WITHOUT changing the existing brand color palette or token values in src/index.css. Specifically: (1) Add a 'lg' size variant to src/shared/ui/Button.tsx (larger padding, min-height 44px touch target, text-base) while keeping existing variants/sizes and tests passing. (2) Create new primitives in src/shared/ui/: EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button, used for no-data states), ProgressSteps.tsx (horizontal/vertical numbered step indicator with current/complete/upcoming states, for guided flows), FieldGroup.tsx (label + helper text + error text wrapper around form inputs for larger readable labels), and Toast.tsx (simple inline/transient feedback message with success/error/info variants). (3) Export all new primitives from src/shared/ui/index.ts. Follow repo conventions strictly: TypeScript, React function components, single quotes, NO semicolons, 2-space indent, use class-variance-authority where variants exist (match the pattern in existing Button.tsx), use the cn helper from @/shared/lib/cn, lucide-react for icons, and the existing --color-atria-* CSS variables for colors. Each new component must be presentational only (no Convex, no data fetching). Add Vitest component tests for each new primitive under src/shared/ui matching the existing test style. Do not modify any feature pages or backend. Do not introduce Radix or shadcn dependencies. All of lint, typecheck, and unit gates must pass.

.hermes-pipeline\20260623_153328\review_codex_iter1.md:32:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

## 0. What "Phase 1" is (locked scope)

Source of truth: `atriax/delivery-phases.md` (re-scope note 2026-06-21) + `atriax/adp-shift-flow-for-maria.md`.

Phase 1 = the **core daily loop**:

1. **Caregiver shift documentation with clock-in / clock-out.**
   - Clock-In **unlocks** the shift note (note cannot start before clock-in).
   - Clock-Out is **blocked** until the shift note is complete (no note, no clock-out).
   - Clock-in and clock-out are also optionally **geofence-locked**: when the agency enables
     the setting, the caregiver can only clock in/out at the patient's address or a configured
     shift-specific service address. Admins and coordinators can enable/disable this rule and
     configure the allowed address/radius.
   - Clock-in and clock-out times are sent to **ADP** as the caregiver's time punches for
     payroll. The shift note and raw location evidence stay in ATRIA-X and are **not** sent to ADP.
   - Order is always: **At the service location Ã¢â€ â€™ Clock In Ã¢â€ â€™ Shift Note Ã¢â€ â€™ Clock Out**.
2. **Coordinator review & approval.** Submitted notes Ã¢â€ â€™ review queue Ã¢â€ â€™ approve (marks the
   shift documented + billing-ready) or request correction (returns to caregiver to fix/resubmit).
3. **Caregiver identity & ADP time sync (only what the shift flow needs).**
   - **Initial load** of caregivers that already exist in ADP, so people match across systems.
   - **New caregiver created in ATRIA-X is reflected in ADP**, so they can clock in/out and be paid.
   - Just enough caregiver create/onboard for a caregiver to log in and run a shift. Full
     candidate application + HR onboarding is **Phase 2** Ã¢â‚¬â€ do not build it here.

Built **on the existing MVP** (Clerk auth, agency tenant, caregiver + coordinator roles, base
layout, shift lifecycle). We extend; we do not rebuild.

NOT in Phase 1 (defer): scheduling/availability, candidate portal, HR onboarding, compliance
engine, billing/invoicing + the full payroll/ADP export for a pay period (Phase 3),
notifications, reporting.


### Locked implementation decisions for this run
- Planning model: **codex only** for planning/review because Claude/Opus is unavailable until next month.
  Implementation/fix model remains **kimi**. When Opus is available again, switch `--plan-mode` back to
  `both` for the stronger opus+codex planning/review flow.
- Theme: **dark theme exactly matching Figma**.
- Geofence default: **off by default** for existing/demo agencies; admins/coordinators can enable it.
- Geofence management: **admins and coordinators** can enable/disable and configure rules/radius/address.
- Geofence enforcement points: **Clock-In and Clock-Out**.
- Default allowed radius: **150 meters**.
- Max accepted GPS accuracy: **100 meters**.
- Location target priority: **shift-specific service address overrides patient/client address**.
- Missing coordinates while geofence is enabled: **block clock-in/out** and show Ã¢â‚¬Å“address needs to be completed.Ã¢â‚¬Â
- ADP status: **no credentials yet**; build plug-and-play with `pending_credentials` queue mode.

---

## 1. The two decisions to make BEFORE coding (blockers)

These gate the build. Resolve both before Session 5 (FE) at the latest; ideally now.

### 1.1 Theme: dark (match Figma) vs keep light teal
The Figma set is **dark** (`atriax/design/design-system-tokens.md`). The live app is **light
teal** (`src/index.css`). "FE exactly as the Figma" Ã¢â€¡â€™ we re-skin the app to the **dark** token
set. The plan below assumes **dark to match Figma**. If you'd rather keep light, the FE
sessions still apply but you skip the dark-token port in Session 5 and the screens won't match
the Figma pixel-for-pixel. **Recommended: go dark to match Figma**, and add light later as a
second token mode (the token doc is already authored mode-swappable).

### 1.2 ADP product + time module (the one thing only ADP can confirm)
The ADP **auth model and worker APIs are stable and we build them concretely now.** The exact
**time-punch endpoint shape depends on which ADP product/time module Maria's agency uses**
(ADP Workforce Now Time & Attendance vs. a different Time module). We therefore build the
punch path behind an **adapter** (Section 3) so the unknown is isolated to one file you fill in
on the day credentials + product confirmation arrive Ã¢â‚¬â€ everything else is done and tested
against a mock. This is the "Do Not Build Yet: ADP payload/export spec" item from the docs,
handled correctly (isolated, not blocking).

Ask Maria/ADP to confirm, when they provision the dev account: (a) product = ADP Workforce
Now? (b) which Time module is in use, (c) whether punches are accepted via real-time event
API or batch import, (d) the sandbox base URL.

### 1.3 Geofence default behavior
Geofence should be **optional and agency-configurable**. The implementation below assumes:
- Default for existing/demo tenants: geofence enforcement **off** until an admin/coordinator enables it.
- When enabled, both Clock-In and Clock-Out require browser geolocation permission and server-side
  distance validation against the client service address or a shift-specific override.
- Default radius: **150 meters**; default max accepted browser accuracy: **100 meters**. Both values
  are tenant settings and can be adjusted by admins/coordinators.
- If the browser denies location or the device reports poor accuracy, the UI shows a plain-language
  blocked state and the Convex mutation rejects the punch.
- Store only operational evidence needed for audit: lat/lng, accuracy, distance, geofence result,
  and the target address label. Do not send this location evidence to ADP.

---

## 2. ADP integration reference (what the flow needs)

This is the resource pack the implementer needs. All of it goes into the Session 3 prompt.

### 2.1 Auth model (stable Ã¢â‚¬â€ build now)
- **OAuth 2.0 `client_credentials` grant + mutual TLS (mTLS).** ADP issues a client
  `x.509` certificate + private key in addition to `client_id` / `client_secret`. Every call
  (token + API) presents the client cert at the TLS layer.
- Token endpoint: `POST https://accounts.adp.com/auth/oauth/v2/token`
  body `grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=...&client_secret=...`, client cert on the
  socket. Returns a bearer `access_token` (~1h TTL). Cache + refresh on expiry.
- API base: `https://api.adp.com` (sandbox base URL differs Ã¢â‚¬â€ ADP will give it; keep it in env).
- Every API call: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` + the same client cert.

### 2.2 Worker APIs (stable Ã¢â‚¬â€ build now)
- **List workers (initial load):** `GET /hr/v2/workers` Ã¢â‚¬â€ paginated (`$top`, `$skip`).
  Returns each worker's `associateOID`, `workerID`, legal name, status. We map
  `associateOID` Ã¢â€ â€™ our `employeeProfiles.adpAssociateOid`.
- **Get one worker:** `GET /hr/v2/workers/{aoid}`.
- **Create / hire a worker (new caregiver Ã¢â€ â€™ ADP):** ADP worker creation is **event-based**:
  `POST /events/hr/v1/worker.hire` (a hire event payload). Returns/forms an `associateOID`
  once processed. Treat as async: submit event Ã¢â€ â€™ poll/receive the resulting worker Ã¢â€ â€™ store the AOID.

### 2.3 Time punches (ISOLATED Ã¢â‚¬â€ adapter, fill in on confirmation)
- The clock-in/clock-out punch POST is the **only** part whose exact endpoint/payload we leave
  as an adapter stub, because it's product-dependent (Section 1.2). The adapter interface is
  concrete; its `postPunch()` body is the fill-in. Likely shapes (confirm one):
  - Real-time event: `POST /events/time/v1/time-entry.create` (or `.modify`) with worker AOID +
    punch timestamp + in/out indicator.
  - Time card read-back for verification: `GET /time/v2/workers/{aoid}/time-cards`.
- We make outbound punches **idempotent** keyed on `(shiftId, punchType)` and store the
  returned ADP id, so a retry never double-punches.

### 2.4 Credentials Ã¢â€ â€™ Convex env vars (set when they arrive Ã¢â‚¬â€ nothing hardcoded)
`ADP_BASE_URL`, `ADP_TOKEN_URL`, `ADP_CLIENT_ID`, `ADP_CLIENT_SECRET`, `ADP_CLIENT_CERT_PEM`,
`ADP_CLIENT_KEY_PEM`. Set via `npx convex env set ...`. Until they exist, the integration runs
in **"pending_credentials"** mode (Section 3.3) Ã¢â‚¬â€ the app works fully, punches queue instead
of failing.

### 2.5 Official docs to read on credential day
`https://developers.adp.com` Ã¢â€ â€™ API Explorer Ã¢â€ â€™ "HR / Worker" and "Time & Attendance" product
guides (JS-gated portal; read in a normal browser when you have the dev-account login). The
worker + auth specs there will match Section 2.1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ2.2; use them to confirm the punch payload in 2.3.

## 3. Architecture additions (so every session prompt is consistent)

### 3.1 Schema additions (Session 1) Ã¢â‚¬â€ extend, never rename prod tables
- `clients`: add optional `serviceAddress` object with human address fields plus optional
  `latitude`/`longitude`. The address is the default geofence target for that client's shifts.
- `shifts`: add optional `clockInAt`, `clockOutAt`, and optional `serviceLocationOverride`
  object (`label`, `addressLine`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `radiusMeters`) for a one-off address
  different from the client's normal address.
- New table **`tenantSettings`** or equivalent tenant-scoped settings table if one does not
  exist yet: include `shiftGeofence` config `{ enabled, enforceClockIn, enforceClockOut,
  defaultRadiusMeters, maxAccuracyMeters }`. Admins/coordinators can edit this. Default: off.
- New table **`timePunches`**: `tenantId`, `shiftId`, `caregiverId`, `punchType`
  (`'clock_in' | 'clock_out'`), `at` (ISO string), `source` (`'atriax'`), optional `location`
  object (`latitude`, `longitude`, `accuracyMeters`, `distanceMeters`, `targetLabel`,
  `targetLatitude`, `targetLongitude`, `withinGeofence`), `adpSyncStatus`
  (`'pending_credentials' | 'queued' | 'synced' | 'error'`), `adpPunchId` (optional),
  `adpError` (optional), `createdAt`. Indexes: `by_tenant_shift`, `by_tenant_sync_status`.
- New table **`employeeProfiles`**: `tenantId`, `clerkUserId` (optional until invite accepted),
  `tenantMemberId` (optional), `displayName`, `email`, `adpAssociateOid` (optional),
  `adpWorkerId` (optional), `adpSyncStatus` (`'pending_credentials' | 'queued' | 'synced' |
  'error' | 'matched'`), `adpError` (optional), `createdAt`. Indexes: `by_tenant`,
  `by_tenant_clerk_user`, `by_tenant_adp_aoid`.
- New table **`integrationConnections`**: `tenantId`, `provider` (`'adp'`), `status`
  (`'pending_credentials' | 'configured' | 'error'`), `lastCheckedAt`, `note`. Index `by_tenant_provider`.
- New table **`integrationEvents`**: `tenantId`, `provider`, `kind` (e.g. `'worker.load'`,
  `'worker.create'`, `'punch.sync'`), `refId` (shiftId/employeeProfileId), `idempotencyKey`,
  `status`, `request` / `response` (sanitized), `createdAt`. Index `by_tenant_idemp`, `by_tenant_created`.
- Run `npx convex codegen` after; never hand-edit `convex/_generated`. Every function goes
  through `convex/authHelpers.ts` (`requireTenant` / `requireTenantRole` / `assertTenantDoc`).

### 3.2 Clock-in/out + geofence gating (Session 2) Ã¢â‚¬â€ server-enforced, twice
- `clockIn(shiftId, location?)` Ã¢â‚¬â€ caregiver-only, tenant-guarded. If geofence is enabled for
  the tenant/shift, the mutation **requires** browser-provided `latitude`, `longitude`, and
  `accuracyMeters`, validates them server-side against the client service address or shift
  override using a Haversine distance helper, and rejects if outside radius or if accuracy is
  worse than `maxAccuracyMeters`. If geofence is disabled, location is optional. On success it
  records `clockInAt` + a `timePunches` clock_in row with the location evidence, transitions
  `scheduled/in_progress` as per `shiftLifecycle.ts`, writes `auditEvents`, and **enqueues**
  an ADP punch sync (Section 3.3). The note becomes editable ONLY after a clock_in exists
  (server rejects note writes otherwise).
- `clockOut(shiftId, location?)` Ã¢â‚¬â€ caregiver-only. If geofence is enabled, validates location
  the same way as clock-in. Also **rejects** unless the shift note passes the existing
  `convex/shiftValidation.ts` completeness check (start/end/services/clientResponse/narrative +
  required-proof tasks). On success records `clockOutAt` + clock_out punch row + audit + enqueues
  ADP sync, and moves the shift to `submitted`.
- Add tenant-guarded admin/coordinator mutations to update geofence settings and client/shift
  service-location data. Admins and coordinators can enable/disable the rule; caregivers cannot.
- Reuse the existing submit path for `submitted`; do not fork it.
- The clock-out gate and the geofence gate are product controls Ã¢â‚¬â€ both must be enforced in Convex,
  not just the UI. Browser geolocation is only input evidence; the server decides pass/fail.

### 3.3 ADP port + adapter (Session 3) Ã¢â‚¬â€ the plug-and-play core
- `convex/integrations/adp/adpPort.ts` Ã¢â‚¬â€ interface: `getAccessToken()`, `listWorkers(cursor)`,
  `createWorker(profile)`, `postPunch(punch)`, `getTimeCards(aoid)`.
- `convex/integrations/adp/adpClient.ts` Ã¢â‚¬â€ the real adapter: OAuth2 client_credentials + mTLS
  using the env vars (2.4), `node:https` Agent with cert/key, token cache. `postPunch()` body is
  the **single fill-in** documented in 2.3 (everything else concrete).
- `convex/integrations/adp/mockAdp.ts` Ã¢â‚¬â€ deterministic mock used in tests + dev.
- **Credential gate:** a tiny `isAdpConfigured()` checks the env vars + `integrationConnections.status`.
  - Not configured Ã¢â€ â€™ all outbound writes mark the row `adpSyncStatus='pending_credentials'` and
    **return success to the app** (queue, don't fail). The shift flow works 100% without ADP.
  - Configured Ã¢â€ â€™ a Convex **scheduler/action** drains queued rows: posts punch / creates worker,
    idempotent by `idempotencyKey`, stores `adpPunchId`/`adpAssociateOid` on success, sets
    `'error'` + `adpError` + bounded retry on failure.
- Plug-and-play day: set env vars (2.4) Ã¢â€ â€™ flip `integrationConnections.status='configured'` Ã¢â€ â€™
  run the initial worker-load action Ã¢â€ â€™ queued punches/workers drain automatically. No code change.

### 3.4 FE Ã¢â‚¬â€ pixel-faithful to the dark Figma
- Source of truth: `atriax/design/design-system-tokens.md` (exact hex/spacing/radius/type) +
  `atriax/design/design-screen-inventory.md` (frame names/IDs) + the live Figma frames.
- The caregiver wizard frames already include **Clock-In** (after Entry, unlocks the note) and
  **Clock-Out** (after the final step, gated by completed note/location) Ã¢â‚¬â€ see the
  figma-mcp-design skill note "INSERTING a screen into an ordered lane". So the design exists;
  we implement it, and add/confirm the location-permission/geofence blocked states in the same
  Figma style if they are not already explicit frames.
- Map shadcn/v0 idioms to the repo's hand-rolled primitives (`src/shared/ui/*`, `@/shared/lib/cn`);
  do NOT add Radix/shadcn deps. Mapping table in `atriax/design-implementation-plan.md Ã‚Â§6`.
- **Non-negotiable FE fidelity workflow:** before any FE implementation session, the agent must
  connect to the talk-to-figma bridge (`mcp_figma_join_channel` + `mcp_figma_get_document_info`),
  export the exact target frames with `mcp_figma_export_node_as_image`, and produce a written
  screen spec containing: frame IDs/names, exported PNG paths, exact copy, layout dimensions,
  colors/tokens, spacing, states, and responsive behavior. kimi implements from that spec; review
  then opens the built app, screenshots it, and compares it against the exported Figma PNGs.
  A FE session is **not accepted** if the screenshots visibly diverge from Figma; the review must
  request a kimi fix pass until the visual match is approved.
- **kimi has no vision and cannot drive the Figma plugin directly.** That is fine: the Hermes
  planning/review stages own the Figma export + visual comparison; kimi only writes code from the
  frozen spec. If the Figma plugin is unavailable, do not start pixel-specific FE sessions Ã¢â‚¬â€ stop
  and reconnect or use already-exported PNGs from the prior pre-step.

## 5. Resources the flow needs (consolidated)

- **Phase-1 scope:** `atriax/delivery-phases.md`, `atriax/adp-shift-flow-for-maria.md`.
- **ADP API model:** Section 2 above (auth + worker concrete; punch isolated) + `developers.adp.com`
  on credential day to confirm the punch payload.
- **Design (FE = exactly Figma):** `atriax/design/design-system-tokens.md` (exact tokens),
  `atriax/design/design-screen-inventory.md` (frame names/IDs), the live Figma file via the
  talk-to-figma bridge (`figma-mcp-design` skill) for exporting reference PNGs. Caregiver
  wizard already has Clock-In/Clock-Out frames; add/verify geolocation permission + blocked
  states in the same style if the frames are not explicit yet.
- **Repo anchors per session:** schema `convex/schema.ts`; lifecycle `convex/shiftLifecycle.ts`;
  validation `convex/shiftValidation.ts`; shifts `convex/shifts.ts`/`shiftQueries.ts`; reviews
  `convex/reviews.ts`; members/invites `convex/members.ts`/`invitations.ts`; guards
  `convex/authHelpers.ts`; caregiver FE `src/features/caregiver/*`; coordinator FE
  `src/features/coordinator/*` + `src/features/dashboard/*`; primitives `src/shared/ui/*`;
  tokens `src/index.css`.
- **Pipeline:** `multi-model-dev-pipeline` skill; gates need Node Ã¢â€°Â¥ 20.12 (bundled v22) + `npm install`.
- **House rules:** multi-tenancy via authHelpers (enforced twice), `npx convex codegen` after
  every backend change, never bill without complete+approved docs, style = single quotes / no
  semicolons / 2-space.

## 6. Honest caveats
- **kimi can't see Figma.** FE fidelity comes from the Hermes/opus/codex pre-step exporting frames via
  the Figma plugin, writing a precise spec, and the review stage comparing live app screenshots against
  those PNGs. If the plugin/exports are unavailable, do not start a pixel-fidelity FE session. Budget for it.
- **ADP punch endpoint is the one true unknown** Ã¢â‚¬â€ isolated to `adpClient.postPunch()`. Everything
  around it (auth, worker load, worker create, queueing, idempotency, UI, gating) is fully built
  and tested against a mock, so "plug and play" is real: on credential day it's env vars + a
  status flip + finalizing one function body.
- **Theme:** the plan assumes dark to match Figma. If you keep light, skip Session 5's dark port
  and accept the Figma won't match pixel-for-pixel.
- **Geolocation is a control, not proof of truth.** Browser geolocation can be denied or spoofed, so the
  server must validate all submitted location evidence and store an audit trail. This is sufficient for
  operational enforcement; it is not a fraud-proof GPS system.
- Each pipeline session is independent and resumable; report each `summary.md` honestly (model
  fallbacks + real gate results) before starting the next.

import { v } from 'convex/values'
import {
  internalMutation,
  internalQuery,
  mutation,
  type MutationCtx,
  type QueryCtx,
} from './_generated/server'
import { internal } from './_generated/api'
import type { Id } from './_generated/dataModel'
import { assertTenantDoc, requireTenantRole } from './authHelpers'
import { adpEnvVarNames, isAdpConfigured } from './integrations/adp/config'

type ClaimResult =
  | {
      type: 'already_synced'
      eventId: Id<'integrationEvents'>
      response?: unknown
    }
  | { type: 'in_flight'; eventId: Id<'integrationEvents'> }
  | { type: 'max_attempts'; attempt: number }
  | { type: 'claimed'; eventId: Id<'integrationEvents'>; attempt: number }

const RETRY_DELAYS_MS = [30_000, 120_000, 300_000, 900_000, 1_800_000]
const IN_FLIGHT_STALE_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000

const adpPunchSyncStatus = v.union(
  v.literal('pending_credentials'),
  v.literal('queued'),
  v.literal('synced'),
  v.literal('error'),
)

const adpEmployeeSyncStatus = v.union(
  v.literal('pending_credentials'),
  v.literal('queued'),
  v.literal('synced'),
  v.literal('error'),
  v.literal('matched'),
  v.literal('created'),
)

export function sanitizeError(error: unknown): string {
  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
  return redactSecrets(message.slice(0, 500))
}

function redactSecrets(message: string): string {
  let redacted = message

  for (const name of adpEnvVarNames()) {
    const value = process.env[name]?.trim()
    if (value) {
      redacted = redacted.split(value).join(`[REDACTED:${name}]`)
    }
  }

  redacted = redacted.replace(
    /Basic\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{10,}/g,
    'Basic [REDACTED]',
  )
  redacted = redacted.replace(
    /Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9_\-./=]{10,}/g,
    'Bearer [REDACTED]',
  )
  redacted = redacted.replace(
    /(token['"]?\s*[:=]\s*)['"]?[A-Za-z0-9_\-./=]{8,}['"]?/gi,
    '$1[REDACTED]',
  )

  return redacted
}

export function normalizeEmail(email: string): string {
  return email.trim().toLowerCase()
}

export function idempotencyKey(kind: string, refId: string): string {
  return `${kind}:${refId}`
}

export function chooseRetryDelayMs(attempt: number): number {
  return RETRY_DELAYS_MS[Math.min(attempt, RETRY_DELAYS_MS.length) - 1]
}

export const loadPunchForAdpSync = internalQuery({
  args: { timePunchId: v.id('timePunches') },
  handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, { timePunchId }) => {
    const punch = await ctx.db.get(timePunchId)
    if (!punch) throw new Error('Time punch not found.')
    return punch
  },
})

export const loadEmployeeProfileForAdpSync = internalQuery({
  args: { employeeProfileId: v.id('employeeProfiles') },
  handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, { employeeProfileId }) => {
    const profile = await ctx.db.get(employeeProfileId)
    if (!profile) throw new Error('Employee profile not found.')
    return profile
  },
})

export const findEmployeeProfileByClerkUserId = internalQuery({
  args: { tenantId: v.id('tenants'), clerkUserId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, { tenantId, clerkUserId }) => {
    return ctx.db
      .query('employeeProfiles')
      .withIndex('by_tenant_clerk_user', (q) =>
        q.eq('tenantId', tenantId).eq('clerkUserId', clerkUserId),
      )
      .unique()
  },
})

export const findEmployeeProfilesByTenant = internalQuery({
  args: { tenantId: v.id('tenants') },
  handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, { tenantId }) => {
    return ctx.db
      .query('employeeProfiles')
      .withIndex('by_tenant', (q) => q.eq('tenantId', tenantId))
      .collect()
  },
})

export const isAdpConfiguredForTenant = internalQuery({
  args: { tenantId: v.id('tenants') },
  handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, { tenantId }) => {
    return isAdpConfigured(ctx, tenantId)
  },
})

export const patchPunchAdpStatus = internalMutation({
  args: {
    timePunchId: v.id('timePunches'),
    tenantId: v.id('tenants'),
    adpSyncStatus: adpPunchSyncStatus,
    adpPunchId: v.optional(v.string()),
    adpError: v.optional(v.string()),
  },
  handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args) => {
    const punch = await ctx.db.get(args.timePunchId)
    if (!punch) throw new Error('Time punch not found.')
    assertTenantDoc(punch, args.tenantId)

    const patch: {
      adpSyncStatus: 'pending_credentials' | 'queued' | 'synced' | 'error'
      adpPunchId?: string
      adpError?: string
    } = { adpSyncStatus: args.adpSyncStatus }
    if (args.adpPunchId !== undefined) patch.adpPunchId = args.adpPunchId
    if (args.adpError !== undefined || args.adpSyncStatus === 'synced') {
      patch.adpError = args.adpError
    }
    await ctx.db.patch(args.timePunchId, patch)
  },
})

export const patchWorkerAdpStatus = internalMutation({
  args: {
    employeeProfileId: v.id('employeeProfiles'),
    tenantId: v.id('tenants'),
    adpSyncStatus: adpEmployeeSyncStatus,
    adpAssociateOid: v.optional(v.string()),
    adpWorkerId: v.optional(v.string()),
    adpError: v.optional(v.string()),
  },
  handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args) => {
    const profile = await ctx.db.get(args.employeeProfileId)
    if (!profile) throw new Error('Employee profile not found.')
    assertTenantDoc(profile, args.tenantId)

    const isSuccessStatus =
      args.adpSyncStatus === 'synced' ||
      args.adpSyncStatus === 'matched' ||
      args.adpSyncStatus === 'created'

    const patch: {
      adpSyncStatus:
        | 'pending_credentials'
        | 'queued'
        | 'synced'
        | 'error'
        | 'matched'
        | 'created'
      adpAssociateOid?: string
      adpWorkerId?: string
      adpError?: string
    } = { adpSyncStatus: args.adpSyncStatus }
    if (args.adpAssociateOid !== undefined) {
      patch.adpAssociateOid = args.adpAssociateOid
    }
    if (args.adpWorkerId !== undefined) patch.adpWorkerId = args.adpWorkerId
    if (args.adpError !== undefined || isSuccessStatus) {
      patch.adpError = args.adpError
    }
    await ctx.db.patch(args.employeeProfileId, patch)
  },
})

export const upsertMatchedEmployeeProfile = internalMutation({
  args: {
    tenantId: v.id('tenants'),
    associateOID: v.string(),
    workerID: v.optional(v.string()),
    displayName: v.string(),
    email: v.string(),
    matchProfileId: v.optional(v.id('employeeProfiles')),
  },
  handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args) => {
    if (args.matchProfileId) {
      const match = await ctx.db.get(args.matchProfileId)
      if (!match) throw new Error('Employee profile not found.')
      assertTenantDoc(match, args.tenantId)
      await ctx.db.patch(args.matchProfileId, {
        adpAssociateOid: args.associateOID,
        adpWorkerId: args.workerID,
        adpSyncStatus: 'matched',
      })
      return args.matchProfileId
    }

    return ctx.db.insert('employeeProfiles', {
      tenantId: args.tenantId,
      displayName: args.displayName,
      email: args.email,
      adpAssociateOid: args.associateOID,
      adpWorkerId: args.workerID,
      adpSyncStatus: 'created',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
  },
})

export const claimIntegrationEvent = internalMutation({
  args: {
    tenantId: v.id('tenants'),
    kind: v.string(),
    refId: v.string(),
    idempotencyKey: v.string(),
    request: v.optional(v.any()),
    maxAttempts: v.number(),
  },
  handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args): Promise<ClaimResult> => {
    const events = await ctx.db
      .query('integrationEvents')
      .withIndex('by_tenant_idemp', (q) =>
        q.eq('tenantId', args.tenantId).eq('idempotencyKey', args.idempotencyKey),
      )
      .order('desc')
      .collect()

    for (const event of events) {
      if (event.status === 'success') {
        return {
          type: 'already_synced',
          eventId: event._id,
          response: event.response,
        }
      }
      if (event.status === 'attempting') {
        const createdAt = new Date(event.createdAt).getTime()
        if (Date.now() - createdAt < IN_FLIGHT_STALE_MS) {
          return { type: 'in_flight', eventId: event._id }
        }
      }
    }

    const latestAttempt = events.find((e) => typeof e.attempt === 'number')
    const attempt = (latestAttempt?.attempt ?? 0) + 1
    if (attempt > args.maxAttempts) {
      return { type: 'max_attempts', attempt }
    }

    const eventId = await ctx.db.insert('integrationEvents', {
      tenantId: args.tenantId,
      provider: 'adp',
      kind: args.kind,
      refId: args.refId,
      idempotencyKey: args.idempotencyKey,
      status: 'attempting',
      attempt,
      request: args.request,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    })

    return { type: 'claimed', eventId, attempt }
  },
})
